correctness.rationale: The cube-edge incidence construction gives twelve sites of degree four. The independent exhaustive replay evaluated both synchronous successors on every one of the 531,441 ternary states, treating GHM states 1 and 2 as unconditional transitions. Functional-graph classification assigns every state its unique eventual cycle, its least period, and its distance to that cycle. The only joint classes were (1,1):512505, (3,3):24, (6,1):48, (8,1):15984 and (12,1):2880, giving 18,912 unequal-period states and the stated 789-fold oscillation probability ratio. The CCA basin spectrum, writing size×multiplicity, was period one: 116×18, 1300×36, 4989×24, 114627×3; three: 3×8; six: 6×8; eight: 416×18 and 472×18; twelve: 360×8. GHM has one fixed basin of 531417 and eight period-three basins of size three. Sharp depths eight and six each occur 72 times, with verified witnesses 31727 and 16188, respectively. The lcm of the CCA periods is 24, and that of GHM is three, which proves the two map identities after the sharp entry times. Acting on temporal-orbit identifiers by the 48 cube maps and three CCA color shifts gives (period,class size) pairs (1,3),(1,18),(1,24),(1,36),(3,2),(3,6),(6,8),(8,18),(8,18),(12,8); the two period-eight classes have respective basin sizes 416 and 472.
residual_risks: The exhaustion is for synchronous threshold two on the specified finite graph and color alphabet; it does not support claims about other thresholds or graphs.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedron is a natural four-regular comparison graph with overlapping triangles and squares. Running the two standard three-color rules at their same two-contact threshold exposes a sharp contrast not captured by naming their periods: the short CCA cycles have no transients, the long CCA cycles have large basins, and almost all oscillatory CCA starts are fixed-point-bound under GHM. The common-state census and geometric classes supply concrete benchmark data for comparisons of threshold dynamics and separate two distinct types of attracting eight-cycles.
residual_risks: The census motivates finite comparisons; it is not a structural theorem for all four-regular graphs or infinite systems.
